F2-L01.intro: Greet, reply, ask how someone is — حَالُكَ to a boy, حَالُكِ to a girl, حَالُكُمْ to a group — answer, and close politely. Short, natural, and always with the paired reply.

roleplays.setting: Meeting your teacher in the morning
roleplays.title: Good morning, Sir!

tasks.task: ASK the teacher how he is (he then answers).
tasks.en: And you, Sir, how are you?

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected: say goodbye politely.

roleplays.setting: A new girl joins your class
roleplays.title: Hello, Sara!

tasks.task: Give the evening reply and welcome her.
ASK Sara how she is — to a girl (she then answers).
tasks.en: How are you, Sara? (to a girl)
I am fine too, thank you.

tasks.task: Say yes and welcome her to the class.
tasks.model: نَعَمْ، أَنَا فِي هٰذَا الصَّفِّ. أَهْلًا بِكِ!
tasks.en: Yes, I am in this class. Welcome! (to a girl)

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected: say goodbye to her.
tasks.model: مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ يَا سَارَةُ، إِلَى اللِّقَاءِ!

roleplays.setting: Helping at a school open evening
roleplays.title: Welcoming a visitor

tasks.task: Give the full reply and welcome him.
tasks.model: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا!
tasks.en: And upon you be peace, God’s mercy and His blessings. Welcome!

tasks.examiner: مَسَاءُ الخَيْرِ يَا بُنَيَّ. كَيْفَ حَالُكَ؟
tasks.task: Reply to the evening greeting and say how you are.
tasks.model: مَسَاءُ النُّورِ! أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ، الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ.
tasks.en: Good evening! I am fine, praise be to God.

tasks.examiner: … بِخَيْرٍ، شُكْرًا. هِيَ فِي الصَّفِّ الآنَ.
tasks.task: ASK how his daughter is (he then answers).
Say it is here, and invite him in.
Answer the unexpected: reply politely and say goodbye.
tasks.en: You’re welcome! Goodbye, see you later.

conversation.qen: Peace be upon you! (Give the reply.)
How are you today? (Answer and ask back.)
conversation.model: أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ، الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، شُكْرًا. وَأَنْتَ؟
conversation.en: I am fine, praise be to God, thank you. And you?

conversation.q: كَيْفَ تُسَلِّمُ عَلَى صَدِيقَتِكَ فِي الصَّبَاحِ؟
conversation.qen: How do you greet your (female) friend in the morning?
conversation.starter: أَقُولُ: صَبَاحُ الخَيْرِ يَا … ! كَيْفَ حَالُكِ؟
conversation.model: أَقُولُ: صَبَاحُ الخَيْرِ يَا مَرْيَمُ! كَيْفَ حَالُكِ؟
conversation.en: I say: Good morning, Maryam! How are you? (to a girl)

conversation.qen: How do you welcome a guest?
conversation.en: I say: Welcome! Hello to you.

conversation.qen: What do you say in the evening?
conversation.model: فِي المَسَاءِ أَقُولُ «مَسَاءُ الخَيْرِ»، وَالرَّدُّ «مَسَاءُ النُّورِ».
conversation.en: In the evening I say “masā’ al-khayr”, and the reply is “masā’ an-nūr”.

conversation.qen: What is the difference between “ḥāluka” and “ḥāluki”?
conversation.model: «حَالُكَ» لِلْوَلَدِ، وَ«حَالُكِ» لِلْبِنْتِ؛ الفَتْحَةُ لِلْمُذَكَّرِ وَالكَسْرَةُ لِلْمُؤَنَّثِ.
conversation.en: “Ḥāluka” is for a boy and “ḥāluki” for a girl; the fatha is masculine and the kasra feminine.

conversation.q: أَيُّ تَحِيَّةٍ تَسْتَعْمِلُ مَعَ أُسْرَتِكَ؟ وَلِمَاذَا؟
conversation.qen: Which greeting do you use with your family, and why?
conversation.model: أَسْتَعْمِلُ «السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ» مَعَ أُسْرَتِي، لِأَنَّهَا تَحِيَّةٌ جَمِيلَةٌ وَمُهِمَّةٌ فِي دِينِنَا.
conversation.en: I use “as-salāmu ʿalaykum” with my family, because it is a beautiful greeting and important in our religion.

conversation.q: سَلِّمْ عَلَى مَجْمُوعَةٍ مِنَ الأَصْدِقَاءِ وَاسْأَلْ عَنْ حَالِهِمْ.
conversation.qen: Greet a group of friends and ask how they are.
conversation.model: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ! كَيْفَ حَالُكُمْ؟ أَنَا سَعِيدٌ بِلِقَائِكُمْ.
conversation.en: Peace be upon you! How are you all? I am happy to see you.

conversation.q: قُلِ الحَرَكَاتِ الأَرْبَعَ: سَلِّمْ، اِسْأَلْ، أَجِبْ، وَوَدِّعْ.
conversation.qen: Do all four moves: greet, ask, answer for yourself, say goodbye.
conversation.starter: مَرْحَبًا يَا … ! كَيْفَ حَالُكَ؟ أَنَا … إِلَى اللِّقَاءِ …
conversation.model: مَرْحَبًا يَا خَالِدُ! كَيْفَ حَالُكَ؟ أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ، الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ. إِلَى اللِّقَاءِ، مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ!
conversation.en: Hello, Khalid! How are you? I am fine, praise be to God. See you later, goodbye!
